turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to start making better coffee at home, and I've got a few choices.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first one is a French press, cheap and simple, but you have to clean out the grounds.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a pour over cone, which makes a really clean cup but takes some practice.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is a pod machine, super fast and easy, but the pods add up over time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is an espresso machine with a milk steamer, which is pretty expensive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you love lattes, the espresso machine is the only one that really gets you there, but it's a big investment. For plain black coffee, the French press or pour over give great flavor for little money. The pod machine wins on convenience but not taste.
